id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

searchable.description: Whether the tree should allow search through a text input.

selectable.description:
Whether the tree should allow to select a node (ie: for previewing the node's data).
The selected node is stored in `selectedNode` and it will be highlighted with a different background color.
Notice this is different from `checked` which is used to select multiple nodes.

signature.description:
Optional field used for performant rendering, it will trigger a re-render of the tree when its value changes.
If not defined, the tree will re-render when either a search is performed, or the number of roots change.

checked.description: A map of the nodes that are checked

expanded.description: A map of the nodes that are expanded

height.description: The height of the tree view in pixels. If not specified, the tree view will take the full height of its container.

loading.description: Whether the tree is loading. If true, a loading skeleton of the tree will be displayed.

roots.description: The root nodes of the trees to display

flattenedNodes.description: The dictionary of nodes in the tree. This is used to quickly find a node by its id.

selectedNode.description: The id of the node that is selected. Only populated if `selectable` is true and a node is clicked.

width.description: The width of the tree view in pixels. If not specified, the tree view will take the full width of its container.

emptyState.description: Represents emptyState component when there is no tree view present.

shouldOpenToSelectedPath.description: Represents whether or not to open directly to the selected path in the tree view.
